parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against the human adenosine A1 receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target name 'Adenosine A1 receptor' and assay organism 'Homo sapiens'. Require canonical SMILES via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
